This is a conditional judgment about warping, not a strength guarantee. Reviewer Nia accepted this limited conclusion. A retelling of P-14 is not an independent trial. Independent trial P-22 used new samples and operator Ada under the same conditions and also favored Luma for warping.
Technician Kez: Sora is usually easier to clean; this is my attributed opinion, not an adopted lab recommendation. QL-7 parts took about 42-58 minutes in profile Z with 0.4 mm nozzle. Trial P-31 failed, but humidity was not measured and the cause is unknown. Lesson: record moisture and actual enclosure before transferring the warping judgment.

pages.content:
---
title: Overview
description: Synthetic print-lab evidence, conditional judgments and unresolved outcomes.
date: 2026-11-09
tags: [overview, synthetic]
---

This synthetic example describes Luma and Sora processing QL-7. It is a compilation of source assertions, not manufacturing advice or an independently accepted atlas conclusion.[^1][^2]

## Key Findings

| Topic | Source-bounded finding |
|---|---|
| Warping | Ivo reports that Luma did better than Sora in P-14 only with dried feedstock, a closed enclosure and 20–24 C ambient temperature; Nia is reported to have accepted that limited judgment. P-22 is described as an independent supporting trial.[^1] |
| Strength | The warping judgment does not guarantee strength.[^1] |
| Cleaning | Kez's preference for Sora is attributed opinion, not an adopted lab recommendation.[^1] |
| Duration | Profile Z with a 0.4 mm nozzle is reported as approximately 42–58 minutes.[^1] |
| Failed case | P-31 failed; humidity was not measured and its cause is unknown.[^1][^2] |

## Navigation

- [Luma and Sora](entities/luma-and-sora.md)
- [Conditional warping judgment](concepts/conditional-warping.md)
- [Trial evidence and gaps](concepts/trial-evidence.md)

[^1]: review.txt
[^2]: events.json

pages.title: Conditional warping
pages.content:
---
title: Conditional warping
description: The limited P-14/P-22 judgment and conditions on its application.
date: 2026-11-09
tags: [conditions, warping]
---

Technician Ivo reports that Luma produced fewer warped QL-7 brackets than Sora in P-14. This is conditional and concerns warping only.[^1]

## Conditions and meaning

| Dimension | Retained condition or limit |
|---|---|
| Feedstock | dried |
| Enclosure | closed |
| Ambient temperature | 20–24 C |
| Compared outcome | warping |
| Excluded inference | no strength guarantee |
| Attribution | Ivo's report; Nia's acceptance is reported in the source |

All conditions above come from review.txt.[^1] Reported source acceptance is distinct from acceptance of this new atlas proposal.

## Supporting experience

The source describes P-22 as a separate trial with new samples and operator Ada, under the same conditions, also favoring Luma for warping. A retelling of P-14 is explicitly not an independent trial.[^1] The [trial page](trial-evidence.md) separates those reports from available event rows and unknown causes.

## Application limit

The source's lesson is to record moisture and the actual enclosure before transferring the warping judgment.[^1] Different machine settings in [machines.csv](../entities/luma-and-sora.md) do not silently establish those conditions for a new case.

[^1]: review.txt

pages.content:
---
title: Trial evidence
description: Observed event fields, reported trials and missing causal evidence.
date: 2026-11-09
tags: [episodes, uncertainty]
---

The event file explicitly labels its observations synthetic and not manufacturing advice.[^1] The review supplies interpretations and an additional reported trial.[^2]

## Episodes

| Episode | Evidence available | Limits |
|---|---|---|
| P-14 | Event row: Luma, QL-7, 22 C, dried=true, enclosure=closed, warped=false.[^1] | This single row alone is not a comparative result; the comparison is Ivo's report.[^2] |
| P-22 | Review reports new samples, operator Ada, same conditions and a result favoring Luma for warping.[^2] | No separate P-22 event row is supplied in events.json.[^1] |
| P-31 | Event row: Sora, QL-7, outcome=failed, humidity=null, cause=null.[^1] | The review also says humidity was unmeasured and the cause unknown; failure does not establish a humidity cause.[^2] |

## Unknowns and reuse

Do not fill missing humidity, infer the cause of P-31, or count retellings of P-14 as independent support.[^2] The [conditional judgment](conditional-warping.md) retains its specific applicability limits. The input documents do not give event dates for these trials; ingestion time does not supply them.

[^1]: events.json
[^2]: review.txt

pages.title: Luma and Sora
pages.content:
---
title: Luma and Sora
description: Machine settings and an attributed cleaning opinion.
date: 2026-11-09
tags: [machines, opinion]
---

Luma and Sora are the two machines named by the synthetic source.[^1]

## Recorded settings

| Machine | Feedstock | Nozzle | Enclosure |
|---|---|---|---|
| Luma | QL-7 | 0.4 mm | closed |
| Sora | QL-7 | 0.6 mm | open |

These are the rows in machines.csv, not evidence that every historical trial used these settings.[^1] The separate [warping judgment](../concepts/conditional-warping.md) has its own explicit conditions.[^2]

## Attributed judgment

Kez says Sora is usually easier to clean. The source explicitly says this is Kez's opinion, not an adopted lab recommendation.[^2]

## Timing

The source reports approximately 42–58 minutes for QL-7 parts using profile Z and a 0.4 mm nozzle. It does not establish an exact duration or a publication/validity date for this estimate.[^2]

[^1]: machines.csv
[^2]: review.txt
